task.title: Entitlement not proven — Part-time employment on an initial or renewal claim

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li:
Comments: Select the appropriate option:
Labour dispute: Type “Labour dispute — entitlement not proven. D5 imposed.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to National Policy on Levels of Decision and EIA 36 . National Policy on Levels of Decision EIA 36

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the labour dispute issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual action: Select 11 - Part week disentitlement on a continuing basis .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work type: Select 15 - Manual Action code 11, 12 or 14 .
Remarks line 1: Type “Labour dispute — part-time employment.”
Remarks line 2: Type “MA11, partial D5 is imposed for [number] days per week starting [date] to [indefinite or disentitlement end date, if known].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

Detection: Select the appropriate option:
If it is a continuing claim and a MA74 must be rescinded, select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review.
In other cases, leave the field blank.

Infraction: Select the appropriate option:
If it is a continuing claim and a MA74 must be rescinded, select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability.
In other cases, leave the field blank.

Message: Select the appropriate option:
If it is a continuing claim and a MA74 must be rescinded, select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement.
In other cases, leave the field blank.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlements (2976):
D5, D12, D13, D14, D23 (3011): Select: D5 - Labour dispute .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to request a Reconsideration .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a client Note and type “Send the saved ACS letter.”
Determine if there is an outstanding Correspondence (COR) Manual Decision WI:
Determine if there is a system-generated ROD with a negative decision:
Create a COR WI as follows:

ul.li: Claim type: Select the appropriate option.
Destination: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Next available user .
Details: Type “D-01-00-01 letter required — labour dispute issue.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the ADJ WI for the labour dispute issue.
